description: This script manages the review lifecycle for components in a software repository by updating metadata YAML files and generating reports. It offers commands to start, stop, and clear review cycles, as well as to display help information.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all component directories containing metadata.yaml files, excluding docs and scripts directories, and lists their relative paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message with usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to the metadata.yaml file for a given component, with error handling if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date by adding a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review lifecycle date fields in a metadata.yaml file by setting them to placeholders.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Invokes an external script to regenerate the RAG status report.
